description: Side panel of TmPdfAnnotator listing annotation threads with kind badges and author colors, filtered through the shared TmPdfThreadFilter (phase 12: the All | Unresolved segmented control). Hosts the draft composer and supports reply, resolve, reopen, and delete. Used internally by TmPdfAnnotator.

parameters.name: SelectedThreadIdChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the selected thread id changes.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Current user id, used for comment permission checks.

parameters.name: ShowResolvedChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the resolved filter toggles.

parameters.name: ColorResolver
parameters.description: Resolves the display color of a thread.

parameters.name: Draft
parameters.description: Pending annotation draft awaiting a note, when present.

parameters.name: ShowChrome
parameters.description: Whether the panel renders its own header (title + ✕ close). Default true — the docked desktop/tablet presentation. When the panel is hosted inside the annotator's mobile bottom sheet (FZE-8), the sheet header owns the title and the close button, so the host passes false and the panel renders only the resolved filter and its body, with the draft composer pinned to the sheet bottom and its buttons split across one row (phase 8 review 12).

parameters.name: DraftColor
parameters.description: Color used for the draft indicator. Defaults to DefaultColor.

parameters.name: OnCreateRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked with the note body when creating the draft annotation.

parameters.name: OnDraftDismissed
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the draft is dismissed.

parameters.name: OnReplyRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a reply is requested.

parameters.name: OnEditRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when an existing comment body is edited.

parameters.name: OnResolveRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when resolving a thread is requested.

parameters.name: OnReopenRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when reopening a thread is requested.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when deleting a comment is requested.

parameters.name: OnCloseRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the panel's close button is pressed.
